name: Clam Soup
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: hot milk per quart of juice
ingredients.originalText: One cupful of hot milk per quart of juice

instructions.text: Remove the clams from the shells as soon as they have opened
Put them in a warm place, until the juice is prepared
Add a cupful of hot milk to a quart of juice
Thicken it with a roux made of one tablespoonful of butter and one tablespoonful of flour
Add the clams, chopped fine, season, and bring the soup again to the boiling-point and serve
Two spoonfuls of whipped cream served on each plateful of soup is an improvement to the dish

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Remove the clams from the shells as soon as they have opened
2. Put them in a warm place, until the juice is prepared
3. Add a cupful of hot milk to a quart of juice
4. Thicken it with a roux made of one tablespoonful of butter and one tablespoonful of flour
5. Add the clams, chopped fine, season, and bring the soup again to the boiling-point and serve
6. Two spoonfuls of whipped cream served on each plateful of soup is an improvement to the dish
